description.value: You know exactly where a cybernetic limb's release catch hides under the skin graft. You can attempt to Steal a mounted or holstered augment component from a creature as though it were a carried item, at a -2 circumstance penalty to the check.

cinderfall.incomplete: This unlocks a new legal target for Steal (an installed/holstered augment) rather than modifying a check already being made against an existing target -- no rule element changes what counts as a valid Steal target.
